title: acropodium suffruticosum

The therapeutic actions of Acropodium suffruticosum include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential of Acropodium suffruticosum as a medicinal plant.
